question: Chandragupta Maurya is said to have converted to:
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Jainism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chandragupta Maurya**, the founder of the **Mauryan Empire**, is said to have converted to **Jainism** in his later years.
 
• He was deeply influenced by **Jain teachings** and the Jain saint **Bhadrabahu**.
 
• Under Bhadrabahu’s guidance, Chandragupta renounced his throne and material possessions to embrace the ascetic life of Jainism.
